Hi,
Maybe something like R markdown will do the trick? It will create a HTML/PDF file with your R output, either text or graphs. It's really easy to work with and the output looks very professional.
  • http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com/
  • Cheat sheet: https://www.rstudio.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/rmarkdown-cheatsheet.pdf
  • Free course here: https://www.datacamp.com/courses/reporting-with-r-markdown
Hope this helps!
